name: Grand Velas Riviera Maya
positioning: All-inclusive beach resort in Playa del Carmen on Mexico's Caribbean Coast, beside the Yucatan jungle
best_for: Couples who want an oceanfront suite with a private plunge pool
Families who want suites near the pool and the Kids' and Teens' Clubs

facts.text: The resort sits on the white sand beaches of Playa del Carmen on Mexico's Caribbean Coast, beside the Yucatan jungle.
Grand Velas Riviera Maya is an all-inclusive resort.
The resort has an infinity pool.
Family suites are around the infinity pool, close to the Kids' and Teens' Clubs and steps from the beach.
The address is Carretera Cancun Tulum Km. 62, Playa del Carmen, Quintana Roo, Mexico.
Rooms are in cream and brown tones with local artwork, dark-wood accents and travertine floors.
Frida serves Mexican cuisine and Sen Lin serves Asian cuisine.
Staff serve drinks at the pool and on the beach.

highlights.text: The oceanfront Grand Class ambiance offers private plunge pools, Jacuzzi tubs and terraces with sunset views.
The family-friendly Zen Grand ambiance has suites with private terraces, jungle surroundings and views of the pool and a Koi pond.
The exterior is light blue and turquoise, and the curved architecture mimics the waves.

considerations.text: The resort is on the Cancun-Tulum highway at Km. 62, in Playa del Carmen on the Riviera Maya.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel less intimate.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
